decision: Adopted as the default: the 0.5G medians lie within the control range in both directions, and the 2G and 5G points again meet the bar.
bar: Follow-up of tap-balance-flows-default.json, stated before running: five interleaved repeats of the 16-flow 0.1%-loss row; balanced 0.5G medians within or above the control range in both directions, and the 2G and 5G points meeting the original bar.

conditions.order: for each of five repeats: hash then flows-balanced with fresh daemons
conditions.isolation: daemons and generators on CPUs 0-19; concurrent builds and remote-host runs only on other CPUs
